local.h: Belmont Shore sewage spill closes coastal waters
local.b: A pressurized main break spilled 29,000 gallons of sewage near Livingston Drive and Second Street Friday evening; Long Beach is making emergency repairs.
local.title: 29,000 gallons of sewage spill in Belmont Shore, forcing city to close coastal waters

goodnews.h: Cal State LA collects underground music memories
goodnews.b: The college invites fans to bring photos, fliers and ticket stubs from their gig-going days for its underground music archive on Nov. 5.

local.h: Visa granted for mom of slain Bronx teen, Mamdani says
local.b: Mayor Mamdani said Trump agreed to immediately grant a visa to the mother of Javits Frimpong, 15, who was shot and killed on his way to school.
local.title: Mamdani says Trump will 'immediately' grant visa to Ghanaian mom of slain Bronx teen

local.h: Jersey City pre-K busing hits crisis point
local.b: Overcrowding at P.S. 16 in booming Paulus Hook means its pre-K toddlers are bused across the city because the building has no room for them.
local.title: Overflowing school in downtown Jersey City is hitting a crisis point, parents say

local.h: Bronx e-bike fire death toll rises to four
local.b: Two teenage boys and a woman have died alongside Zion Maine after an e-bike battery ignited in the family's 11th-floor kitchen, blocking their exit.
local.title: Bronx e-bike fire that killed a boy has claimed 3 more lives, NYPD says

goodnews.h: Formerly homeless New Yorkers lead outreach
goodnews.b: Outreach worker Felipe Ramos, who cycled through homelessness himself, says his past is his superpower in getting people off Manhattan's streets.
goodnews.title: How formerly homeless New Yorkers are helping others get off the streets

goodnews.h: Hate crime survivor reclaims his marathon dream
goodnews.b: A year after an attack cost him his first marathon, Daniel Cho will join more than 18,000 first-timers at this year's NYC Marathon.
goodnews.title: A violent hate crime claimed one NYC man's marathon dream. A year later, he's taking it back.

local.h: Hundreds of thousands protest again in France
local.b: Organizers said nearly half a million joined the third straight weekend of protests, including 200,000 in Paris; authorities put turnout at 320,000.

local.h: Fitch cuts France's outlook to negative
local.b: The agency now expects French debt to rise from about 115.7% of GDP in 2025 to 124% in 2028, citing weaker growth and higher yields.
